summary: Strive, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce routine bitcoin purchases and updates to its cash, bitcoin, STRC preferred stock holdings, and share counts. During August 10-14, 2026, it bought 79 bitcoin at an average price of $63,231, increasing total holdings to 20,246. Cash equivalents remained flat at $154.8 million, and share counts rose by 597,150 Class A shares. This is a standard treasury update, not a special situation; no extraordinary corporate event is disclosed. Watch for continued bitcoin accumulation and dilution from share issuance.
